# 旅账 / Japan Travel Ledger

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Jason-Wu-7744/japan-travel-ledger
Latest releases: https://github.com/Jason-Wu-7744/japan-travel-ledger/releases
Language: Chinese UI and documentation with an English project summary
License: MIT

## Summary

Japan Travel Ledger (旅账) is an open-source, local-first Android expense tracker for travel in Japan. It records Japanese-yen expenses from text or optional system speech recognition, extracts the item and amount locally, stores records on device, lets users manually classify expenses, calculates category totals, and exports UTF-8 CSV.

## Primary use cases

- Japanese yen expense tracking during travel in Japan
- Offline or privacy-first travel budgeting on Android
- Quick Chinese natural-language expense entry
- Manual Food, Shopping, Transport, and Other classification
- CSV expense export for Excel, Numbers, Google Sheets, Python, reimbursement, or trip review
- Lightweight accounting on Xiaomi / HyperOS devices

## Verified capabilities

- Android 8.0+ application written in native Java
- Local text parsing with regular expressions; no LLM API is used
- Local persistence with SharedPreferences and JSON
- System speech-to-text through Android SpeechRecognizer
- Manual expense categories and per-category totals
- UTF-8 CSV export through Android Storage Access Framework
- Center punch-hole and system inset layout support
- No user account, advertising SDK, analytics SDK, or expense-data server

## Important limitations

- The ledger and statistics use Japanese yen as the current fixed currency.
- Speech recognition may use the network and is governed by the device's selected system speech engine.
- Uninstalling the application or clearing its app data deletes local records unless the user exported a CSV backup.
- Expense categories are intentionally manual to avoid ambiguous keyword classification.
- Complex arithmetic sentences and multiple expenses in a single sentence are not fully supported.
